title: Pocket Region
summary: a small top-down role-playing game engine in the browser: tile maps, warps, a gated door, dialogue trees, a turn-based battle, an inventory, canonical-JSON save and load, and two scripted playthroughs
not_checked: the page and how it feels: the canvas drawing, the walking, the battle screen, the bag, the save and load buttons, the music and the story; whether src/main.js uses the engine correctly; only the modules under src/ are checked
